2.name: Bonus Cantrip & Natural Recovery
2.description: Learn an extra Druid cantrip; once per Long Rest during a Short Rest recover expended spell slots totaling <= ceil(Druid level / 2).

6.name: Land's Stride & Circle Spells
6.description: Move through nonmagical difficult terrain freely, ignore nonmagical thorny damage, and Adv vs plant magic; Circle Spells unlock L3/5/7/9.

10.name: Nature's Ward
10.description: Cannot be Charmed or Frightened by Elementals or Fey, and immune to Poison and Disease.

14.name: Nature's Sanctuary
14.description: Beasts and Plant creatures must pass a WIS save to attack you.

2.name: Combat Wild Shape & Circle Forms
2.description: Wild Shape as a Bonus Action, expend spell slots to heal 1d8/lvl while transformed, and assume Beast forms up to CR 1 (later Druid level / 3 from L6+).

6.name: Primal Strike
6.description: Your attacks in Beast form count as magical; Wild Shape max CR increases to floor(Druid level / 3).

10.name: Elemental Wild Shape
10.description: Expend two uses of Wild Shape simultaneously to transform into an Air, Earth, Fire, or Water Elemental.

14.name: Thousand Forms
14.description: Cast Alter Self at will without expending a spell slot.

2.name: Balm of the Summer Court
2.description: Pool of d6s equal to Druid level: Bonus Action heals ally within 120 ft (up to half level dice) +1 Temp HP per die.

6.name: Hearth of Moonlight and Shadow
6.description: Short/Long Rest sphere hides your camp, boosts Stealth/Perception by +5, and hides firelight.

10.name: Hidden Paths
10.description: Bonus Action teleports yourself 60 ft or Action teleports an ally 30 ft (WIS mod/Long Rest).

14.name: Walker in Dreams
14.description: End a Short Rest to cast Dream, Scrying, or Teleportation Circle back to your previous Long Rest spot (1/Long Rest).

2.name: Speech of the Woods & Spirit Totem
2.description: Learn Sylvan and communicate with Beasts; Bonus Action summons a 30-ft Bear, Hawk, or Unicorn Spirit Totem (1/Short Rest).

6.name: Mighty Summoner
6.description: Beasts and Fey summoned by your spells gain +2 HP per Hit Die and magical natural weapons.

10.name: Guardian Spirit
10.description: Summoned Beasts and Fey ending turns inside your Spirit Totem regain HP equal to half your Druid level.

14.name: Faithful Summons
14.description: If incapacitated/reduced to 0 HP, automatically conjure four Beasts via Conjure Animals (9th-level equivalent, 1/Long Rest).

2.name: Halo of Spores & Symbiotic Entity
2.description: Reaction deals 1d4->1d10 Necrotic damage (CON save); spend Wild Shape for 4x Druid level Temp HP, +1d6 weapon Necrotic, and doubled Halo dice.

6.name: Fungal Infestation
6.description: Reaction animates a Beast/Humanoid dying within 10 ft as a 1-HP Zombie under your command (WIS mod/Long Rest).

10.name: Spreading Spores
10.description: Bonus Action projects Halo of Spores as a 10-ft cube within 30 ft.

14.name: Fungal Body
14.description: Cannot be Blinded, Deafened, Frightened, or Poisoned, and critical hits against you become normal hits.

2.name: Star Map & Starry Form
2.description: Gain Guidance + free Guiding Bolt casts (PB/Long Rest); expend Wild Shape as Bonus Action for Archer (1d8+WIS radiant), Chalice (extra heal), or Dragon (min 10 Concentration/INT/WIS).

6.name: Cosmic Omen
6.description: Roll Weal (add 1d6) or Woe (subtract 1d6) as a Reaction within 30 ft (PB/Long Rest).

10.name: Twinkling Constellations
10.description: Archer & Chalice scale to 2d8, Dragon grants 20-ft Fly Speed, and you can switch Starry Form each turn.

14.name: Full of Stars
14.description: While in Starry Form, gain Resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.

2.name: Summon Wildfire Spirit
2.description: Expend Wild Shape to summon a Fiery Spirit (Bonus Action command, Flame Seed, and 15-ft Fiery Teleportation).

6.name: Enhanced Bond
6.description: Add +1d8 to one Fire damage or healing roll of your spells when your Wildfire Spirit is summoned, and cast spells from its space.

10.name: Cauterizing Flames
10.description: Spectral flames turn deaths within 30 ft into 2d10 + WIS mod healing or Fire damage reactions (PB/Long Rest).

14.name: Blazing Revival
14.description: If reduced to 0 HP within 120 ft of your Wildfire Spirit, drop the Spirit to 0 HP instead to revive at half HP (1/Long Rest).
